events.headline: First appearance in Cookie Run: Kingdom
events.body: White Lily Cookie first appears in Cookie Run: Kingdom as an Ancient Hero whose journey is defined by truth, sacrifice, courage, friendship, and hope.

events.headline: Playable release
events.body: White Lily Cookie becomes playable in Cookie Run: Kingdom, stepping into the story as a legendary Ancient Hero.

events.headline: Dawnbringer awakening
events.body: White Lily Cookie awakens as the Dawnbringer, carrying the light forward into a new chapter of her legend.

events.headline: Personal remembrance
events.body: The creator's chosen annual remembrance date for White Lily Cookie — a quiet moment to honor her legend of truth and sacrifice.

purevanilla.name: Pure Vanilla Cookie
purevanilla.title: The Light of Hope
purevanilla.editor_note: Game lore presented as canon; PureLily section describes a fan-interpreted relationship. Verify any additional dates against reliable sources before presenting them as facts.

events.headline: Original playable release
events.body: Pure Vanilla Cookie is first released as a playable Cookie in Cookie Run: Kingdom.

events.headline: King of the Vanilla Kingdom
events.body: Pure Vanilla Cookie is the gentle and wise king of the Vanilla Kingdom, a realm built on healing, harmony, and hope.

events.headline: Healing abilities
events.body: Pure Vanilla Cookie's magic centers on healing and restoration, mending both wounds and weary hearts across the kingdoms.

events.headline: Role in the story
events.body: Pure Vanilla Cookie guides the heroes with quiet wisdom, standing as a beacon of hope and a steady light through the darkest moments.

purelily.title: Where Lily Meets Vanilla
purelily.intro: A gentle chapter about the bond between White Lily Cookie and Pure Vanilla Cookie — and what it means to the fans who cherish it.

sections.heading: Their first story connection
sections.body: White Lily Cookie and Pure Vanilla Cookie share roots in the same ancient world of Cookie Run: Kingdom, both carrying the weight of legacy and the quiet strength of those who came before them.

sections.heading: Shared history and emotional significance
sections.body: Their connection is one of mutual respect and quiet understanding — two souls shaped by duty, sacrifice, and the hope of protecting what they love. For many fans, this bond represents the comfort of being seen and the courage found in shared purpose.

sections.heading: Important verified story milestones
sections.body: Both Cookies appear as Ancient Heroes within Cookie Run: Kingdom's overarching story. Their individual arcs — White Lily's Dawnbringer awakening and Pure Vanilla's healing light — intersect in themes of truth, redemption, and hope.

sections.heading: A personal tribute to PureLily
sections.body: PureLily is a fan-named pairing celebrating the bond between White Lily Cookie and Pure Vanilla Cookie. This tribute honors that fan-created name, the art and stories it inspires, and the gentle hope it represents — without claiming it as official canon.

memory_card.body: The creator's personal memory card titled 'The Last Dance,' honoring the PureLily bond on a date meaningful to them. This is a personal remembrance, not an official Cookie Run event.
